name: UPS (NUT)
author: NetMaster
description: Alerts when the power goes out and your UPS runs on battery, when the battery is low or needs replacing, and when the power is back. Reads a NUT server: a Synology or QNAP NAS, a Raspberry Pi, pfSense/OPNsense or Home Assistant's NUT add-on with the UPS connected by USB.

settings.label: NUT server address
settings.help: The IP or name of the device the UPS is connected to. On a Synology NAS: Control Panel → Hardware & Power → UPS → enable network UPS server and add this computer's IP.

settings.label: UPS name (optional)
settings.help: Leave empty to watch every UPS on the server. Synology calls its UPS "ups".

settings.label: Username (optional)
settings.help: Usually not needed just to read the status.

settings.label: Warn when less than this many minutes of battery remain

actions.label: Check now
actions.help: Reads the UPS right away and shows what it reports.

notifications.label: Power cut and UPS battery
notifications.desc: The UPS runs on battery, its battery is low or worn out, or the power is back.
notifications.match: ^UPS .+ (?:is running on battery|battery is almost empty|battery needs replacing|is overloaded)$|^Power is back on UPS
